name: Renewal risk review
summary: Once a month, the account manager sees every contract coming up for renewal on one page: the dates that matter, the warning signs your organization watches for, which accounts are at risk, and the next step for each with an owner and a date. A person decides and makes every contact.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work: the organization's own settings as the only authority, the notice date as the deadline, every next step with one owner and one due date, and a person who decides and makes every contact.

sources.contribution: The method this template adapts: a default look-ahead of 120 days over contracts or renewals; warning signs (quiet accounts, a changed contact or signer, open escalations, falling usage, expansion talk, automatic or multi-year terms) that raise or lower each renewal's risk; a three-way verdict shown with its evidence; the next move for each account at risk; expansion candidates; record problems such as missing amounts or dates after the contract end; telling a blank value from one never read; working from an uploaded export, anchoring dates on a stated day, and working a renewal's dates back from the contract end.
